title: Irish Green Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy stir fry recipe with a delicious Irish twist, featuring juicy chicken, crunchy green vegetables, and savory olives.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the sliced cabbage, bell peppers, and green onions to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 3-5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir in the soy sauce.
Add the sliced olives to the skillet and cook for an additional minute.
Serve the Irish Green Stir Fry hot, garnished with additional green onions if desired.
